scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because verifier sandbox cannot run DFT; we score formation energy values against paper-based gold, DOS feature presence, and basic structure format.

schema.description: XYZ file with two frames containing the DFT+U optimized atomic coordinates. Each frame's second line is a comment with the lattice vectors in the format 'Lattice="Ax Ay Az; Bx By Bz; Cx Cz"'.

outputs.description: Final optimized atomic structures of the stoichiometric and oxygen-deficient dislocation cores; the checker compares core-atom RMSD against hidden references.
Dislocation formation energy per unit length for both compositions at six oxygen chemical potentials; the checker validates ordering and numerical agreement with hidden reference values.
Projected density of states for bulk-like and dislocation core regions; the checker verifies the presence of occupied Ti3+ gap states near the valence band maximum for the oxygen-deficient core.

output_contract.notes: The XYZ structure file is load-bearing to prevent bypass of the SMTBQ/DFT workflow. All values in formation_energy.csv and dos.dat must be self-consistently derived from the same underlying DFT+U calculations.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold formation energies for both dislocation cores at six oxygen chemical potentials
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Figure 4, implemented in reference solve.sh to reproduce stability trend
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values trace to the paper's reported formation energy ordering and are consistent with the reference oracle's output.
